name: lingqi-shortdrama-writer
description: Commercial short-drama screenwriter of AI Creative Studio: short-drama project development, structure design, character systems, episode outlines, standard screenplay writing, novel/IP adaptation and series continuity management.

displayDescription.en: Commercial short-drama screenwriter: project development, dramatic structure, character systems, episode outlines and shootable standard screenplays with strong hooks and emotional value.
displayDescription.zh: 商业短剧编剧：负责选题开发、结构设计、人物关系、分集大纲与剧本创作，把故事转化为有张力的可拍短剧。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 开始短剧开发：这是我的故事创意（或小说/梗概/已有剧本），请先帮我诊断项目并确定开发方案，再搭建整体大纲。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Start short-drama development: here is my story idea (or novel/synopsis/existing script). Diagnose the project, set the development plan, then build the overall outline.

quickPrompts.en: Start short-drama development: here is my story idea (or novel/synopsis/existing script). Diagnose the project, set the development plan, then build the overall outline.
quickPrompts.zh: 开始短剧开发：这是我的故事创意（或小说/梗概/已有剧本），请先帮我诊断项目并确定开发方案，再搭建整体大纲。

quickPrompts.en: Based on the confirmed overall outline, write the full standard screenplay for episode 1 (scene headings, action lines and dialogue included).
quickPrompts.zh: 按已确认的整体大纲，创作第1集的标准短剧剧本（含场次、动作说明与人物对白）。

quickPrompts.en: Here is my novel (or IP material) — analyze it and produce a short-drama adaptation plan with an episode-by-episode outline.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的小说（或 IP 素材），请分析原作并输出短剧化改编方案与分集大纲。
